symptom: After the insurer edit form was stable and the logo file input existed, the authenticated proof observed fileCount=0 immediately after file selection.

rootCause.behavior: refreshOwnerView rebuilt the open insurer ficha during editing.
rootCause.stateLoss: ficha(..., preserveState=true) preserved draft/credentialDrafts but omitted logoFile, while DOM replacement necessarily cleared the browser FileList.
rootCause.userImpact: A user can select a logo and have the pending file silently disappear before Guardar cambios if asynchronous knowledge hydration completes during the edit.

rules: Async knowledge hydration never replaces an actively edited insurer form.
Any legitimate preserveState reconstruction carries pending logoFile and knowledgeRefreshPending.
